evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/m/b extends the plugin-panel base, owns JTextArea plus UndoManager, initializes notes text from NotesConfig and registers Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y actions plus focus-save behavior.
Its helper paths preserve the distinctive warnings 'Notes Document Unable To Undo', 'Notes Document Unable To Redo' and 'Notes Document Bad Location'.
RuneLite NotesPanel has the same JTextArea/UndoManager structure, the same control-Z/control-Y actions, identical warning strings and the same save-on-focus-lost notesData behavior.

proposals.note: Source-proven RuneLite NotesPanel identity; flattened anonymous listeners remain separate unnamed exact-v308 classes.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/m/f carries plugin name 'Notes', descriptor 'Enable the Notes panel' and notes_icon.png.
The plugin injects the toolbar/config/panel services, constructs the notes navigation surface and removes it on shutdown.
RuneLite NotesPlugin preserves the exact plugin name and descriptor, NotesConfig/NotesPanel pairing, toolbar navigation and notes_icon.png resource.
Exact v308 rs/s/m/a is the notes config interface: it uses the notes group and exposes one notesData String getter/setter pair.
RuneLite NotesConfig uses @ConfigGroup('notes') and the same hidden notesData String getter plus notesData(String) setter contract.
Sibling rs/s/m/f resolves this config and rs/s/m/b consumes it to load/save editor text.
